And after some time spent therein, the Deputy Speaker assumed the Chair. 
The following Bill was reported: 
Bill 17 Fiscal Measures Statutes Amendment Act, 2026 — Hon. Mr. Horner 
Third Reading 
On the motion that the following Bill be now read a Third time: 
Bill 17 Fiscal Measures Statutes Amendment Act, 2026 — Hon. Mr. Horner 
A debate followed. 
The question being put, the motion was agreed to. 
On the motion that the following Bill be now read a Third time: 
Bill 20 Appropriation (Supplementary Supply) Act, 2026 ($) — Hon. Mr. Horner 
A debate followed. 
The question being put, the motion was agreed to. 
On the motion that the following Bill be now read a Third time: 
Bill 19 Appropriation Act, 2026 ($) — Hon. Mr. Horner 
A debate followed. 
Pursuant to Standing Order 64(5), at 2:15 p.m. the Deputy Speaker interrupted the 
proceedings and immediately put the question on the Appropriation Bill standing on the 
Order Paper for Third Reading, which was agreed to on the voice vote. With Ms Pitt in 
the Chair, the names being called for were taken as follows:
